### Out of scope

## Rationale
Why is this change needed? Root cause or workaround? Evidence level:

## Acceptance criteria (defined before implementation)
- [ ] Criteria met; evidence linked below

## Evidence
- READ: source/diff reviewed:
- COMPILED: CI run URL / result:
- PACKAGED: release and checksum manifest, if applicable:
- INSTALLED: installer result/hash, if applicable:
- OBSERVED: sanitized gameplay results, if applicable:

## Safety and release checks
- [ ] Regression tests for affected features recorded, or explain why not applicable.
- [ ] STATUS.md and CHANGELOG.md updated.
- [ ] No unrelated changes; preserved source baseline.
- [ ] No logs, cx.cfg, saves, DLLs, tokens, secrets or personal paths/usernames committed; inspect diff and attachments before merging.
- [ ] Rollback instructions stated; existing configuration, saves and backups preserved.
- [ ] Conventional Commit title; review checks before optional merge. Direct commits to main follow the same acceptance and evidence requirements.

## Rollback
Exact revert/restore procedure, or no runtime changes:
